text:
omar: Quick check — I'm gating the catalog launch on a couple of open models. Who's owning the fenrir-lite ingest + licensing matrix? Need perf profiles for seq=2048.

lina: I can take ownership for fenrir-lite intake. Legal sign-off still pending (waiting on export review). Perf benchmark queued, running on a4x2 tomorrow morning.

mike-volumes: FYI legal asked for the model weights provenance and a dependency list. @lina can you attach SPDX/license URL and a small README for the artifact? :thinking:

lina: linking manifest: https://artifacts.internal/models/fenrir-lite/manifest.json (contains license, sha256, weights provenance). Also adding a short README to the PR.

legal-bot: Automod: added label `legal-review-required`. Assigned: @sarah-legal.

sarah-legal: I'll take a look by EOD tomorrow. If export control/embargo is flagged we need the training-data statement + third-party deps list. Please add that to the artifact.

cheung: Perf run in staging hit OOM on seq=2048 bs=1 with current config. Trying seq=1024 next. Error snippet below:
```bash
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 2.1G (tried to allocate key/value cache)
```

devex: Two quick suggestions — (1) try reduced kv cache pre-allocation and (2) a grouped quantize pass. Example config:
```json
{"kv_cache_prealloc": false, "quantize": true, "dtype": "fp16", "group_size": 128}
```
This often recovers ~20% memory and 10% latency overhead.

omar: Good. Can we get a perf summary (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput) and a cost delta vs rtx-6000 for seq=1024 and 2048 by Monday? Also we need an owner for the rollout canary and a PR to pin the model metadata/version.

lina: I'll collect perf numbers and open the model-metadata PR (refs #4521). Canary owner? @mike-volumes can you take it?

mike-volumes: I can own the canary. Proposed rollout: 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% for 6h -> 100% if metrics stable. I'll add a dashboard with latency, error-rate, prompt-eval quality, and a rollback playbook.

omar: Please also wire a prompt-set eval for the catalog so quality regressions trigger alerts (we had a silent drift last quarter). And confirm embeddings shape matches our ingest pipeline (we need float32 [n,1536] compatibility).

cheung: Adding a migration test for embeddings. If legal or perf blocks persist, I'll flag a launch freeze in #product and escalate.

sarah-legal: Quick update — license is MIT-compatible but tokenizer uses Apache-2.0; that's acceptable. Export review scheduled tomorrow morning. No blockers expected but I'll confirm.

omar: Great. Summary action items: lina — perf runs + artifacts + open PR; mike-volumes — canary config + dashboards + playbook; cheung — embeddings test; sarah-legal — sign-off. Ping me if anything slips or if we need to delay launch. :thumbsup:
